jobs.occupation: Sustainability Specialist (m/w/d) (Umwelt-Auditor/in)
jobs.description:
ENERCON GmbH
We are seeking a highly motivated Sustainability Specialist to join our team: This position will play a pivotal role in driving various sustainability programs across our worldwide operations, supporting the further development of our sustainability strategy and communicating our sustainability initiatives and successes.
The ideal candidate will have a thorough understanding of the current sustainability landscape, a strong interest for communication and working collaboratively on sustainability programs with different departments - but above all - be passionate about all aspects of sustainability.
Interested in actively shaping the sustainability journey, all while working for the global energy transition? We are looking forward to hearing from you!

Your responsibilities:

- Actively contribute to the implementation, further development and anchoring of ENERCON's company-wide sustainability strategy and related roadmaps, including the identification of gaps, priorities and next steps
- Drive the development of customer-oriented sustainability solutions and value propositions in close collaboration with relevant functions
- Coordinate cross-functional and international working groups to support the implementation, integration and tracking of sustainability initiatives, including circularity initiatives
- Monitor and analyze sustainability-related regulations, market trends, competitor activities and stakeholder expectations to derive actionable recommendations for ENERCON's sustainability strategy, roadmaps and reporting
- Manage the collection, consolidation and quality assurance of selected sustainability steering KPIs for internal steering, decision making and performance tracking
- Lead selected sustainability communications, including the annual sustainability highlight report, and contribute to communication planning for internal and external target groups in close coordination with Corporate Communications and relevant stakeholders

Your qualifications:

- Graduate degree in sustainability or business administration, preferably in the field of circularity, energy, climate change or environment and relevant professional experience in the field of energy, circularity, communication, auditing or consulting
- 3+ years of experience in a position in sustainability
- Strategic and analytical mindset, with the ability to identify gaps, derive priorities and translate sustainability topics into actionable initiatives
- Excellent understanding of sustainability standards, reporting frameworks and regulatory developments, such as CSRD, Circular Economy Act, etc.
- Strong project management skills, including the ability to prioritize tasks, manage deadlines and lead cross-functional initiatives in a collaborative environment
- Clear communication and interpersonal abilities, with the capacity to engage stakeholders at different levels and present complex sustainability topics in an accessible way
- Preferably international work experience and intercultural awareness
- Highly articulate with excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and German
- Willingness to travel to the headquarters in Northern Germany

jobs.occupation: Associate, GOglobal Graduate Program Inhouse Consulting (Trainee Program) (all genders) (Wirtschaftsingenieur/in)
jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

Your role:

The GOglobal Graduate Program (GGP) is the company’s career accelerator for high potential graduates who are early in their careers. During the 24-month talent development program, you will gain experience through a combination of strategic management consulting projects and functional rotations tailored to your interests and development goals. These rotations may take place across Healthcare, Life Science, Electronics, and Group Functions.

In the first year, you will be working in the Inhouse Consulting team, where you will have the opportunity to tackle challenging problems under the guidance of experienced consultants and to acquire extensive management and problem-solving skills. Inhouse Consulting projects focus primarily on strategy, growth, as well as operational optimization, and our internal clients are typically senior-level executives within the company. The first year will help you to gain a good knowledge of the company and maximize your exposure to different subjects and stakeholders. You will also participate in targeted professional trainings as well as our coaching & mentoring program to continuously improve your technical expertise and business acumen.

In the second year, you will be working on several individual assignments within our sectors: Healthcare, Life Science, Electronics and Group Functions. Depending on our business needs and your preference, you’ll get the chance to expand your network and gain in-depth knowledge in the day-to-day operations of different functions, such as marketing, R&D, production, and strategic management. Each assignment will last three to four months, with one international assignment.

Overall, the program allows you to gain the skills and knowledge needed to become an early thought leader in an area, as well as the ability to independently manage complex projects and diverse stakeholders within a matrix organization.

After successful completion, you will move into an exciting role within one of our businesses depending upon your interest and career aspirations, professional development opportunities, and business needs from which you will continue your development as a future leader within the organization.

Next start date: March 2027, limited contract for two years; Position is based in Darmstadt, Germany with no support for relocation from outside Europe possible.

- Strong analytical skills, excitement for complex and ambiguous work, curiosity for our diverse business sectors and a broad range of topics.
- Outstanding communication and team-work skills.
- Proactive and self-motivated mindset.
- Outstanding academic achievements.
- Profound knowledge of MS Office (especially Excel and PowerPoint).
- Excellent verbal and written English (German is a plus).

jobs.occupation: Automation Engineer (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Automatisierungstechnik)
jobs.description:
What to expect
• You own our native mobile end-to-end test automation stack (Maestro, iOS and Android), taking ownership of architecture, conventions, and suite health. You keep the suite small, deterministic, and cross-platform, because a reliable smoke and regression suite beats a large, flaky one.
• You design and operate AI-driven test workflows where agents generate Maestro flows from specs and test cases (TestRail, Confluence), self-heal selectors, and triage failures. You review and harden everything the agents produce.
• You drive testability into the product and build deterministic test foundations through stubbing, fixtures, and contract tests.
• You own our CI quality gates (Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and define where the test-pyramid boundary sits.
• You review and elevate the work of our developers and manual QA, coaching them on writing testable code and on reviewing AI-generated tests.
• You extend automation to our web stack (Playwright, Angular) where it adds value, always keeping the overall suite lean and reliable.

Your background
• You have 5+ years in test automation or SDET roles, with at least two of them owning test infrastructure (frameworks, CI, environments, test data), not just authoring suites.
• You have delivered native mobile end-to-end automation on real projects (Maestro, Appium, XCUITest, or Espresso) and can explain the flakiness trade-offs between them.
• You bring developer-level scripting and programming ability (Kotlin, Swift, TypeScript, or Python) and read app code to add testability hooks yourself.
• You have hands-on experience with LLM and agent tooling (Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) in a testing workflow, or credible evidence that you will adopt it fast. This is core to the role, not a nice-to-have.
• You have a clear stance on test-data determinism through stubbing, fixtures, and contract tests, and you have a proven track record of eliminating flakiness and keeping suites deterministic.
• You ideally bring experience in CI/CD pipeline ownership (including device farms and simulators), web E2E with Playwright, white-label or multi-tenant product experience, visual and snapshot regression testing, and TestRail integration and reporting.
• You communicate clearly in English and collaborate well with Product Owners and cross-functional teams.

What we offer
• The opportunity to develop freely in a growing company within a dynamic industry, shape the future, and continuously develop yourself.
• The chance to take on responsibility from day one and leverage our short and fast decision-making processes to make an impact.
• Flexible working hours based on trust and 30 days of vacation.
• The possibility to work remotely several days per week.
• An attractive, competitive salary and a variety of additional benefits (HVV ProfiCard, pension subsidy, etc.).

jobs.occupation: Master student in the field of Acoustics - Interior Noise (d/f/m) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support the Airbus Interior Noise department, Airbus Operations is looking for a

Master student in the field of Acoustics - Interior Noise (d/f/m)

You are looking for a master thesis and want to get to know the work of an Acoustics Engineer (d/f/m)? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Interior Noise department as a master student (d/f/m)!

- Location: Hamburg
- Start: 01.01.2027
- Duration: 6 months

We are offering a Master Thesis opportunity focusing on acoustics, specifically interior noise. This role provides a unique chance to contribute to cutting-edge aerospace research and development within a leading global company.

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Your benefits

- Work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Conducting in-depth research and analysis of interior noise sources and propagation within aircraft cabins.
- Developing and applying advanced simulation models and experimental methodologies for acoustic analysis.
- Evaluating and comparing different noise reduction strategies and materials.* Collecting and analyzing data from various sources, including laboratory tests and flight measurements.
- Documenting research findings and presenting results in a clear and concise manner.
- Collaborating with experienced engineers and researchers within the acoustics department.

Desired skills and qualifications

Working student (d/f/m) for Industrial Architecture

You are a full time student, looking for a working student position and want to get to know the work of an Industrial Architect?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in department designation as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

At Airbus, Industrial Architecture is driving the next evolution of flight. - Location: Hamburg
- Start: 01.11.2026

You will receive a collectively agreed salary of at least €18.53 per hour, depending on the job. There are also special payments such as vacation pay.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location: Hamburg Finkenwerder

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Are you wondering how you actually get from university to Airbus? Your working student position is at the Finkenwerder plant and you can take the ferry from Teufelsbrück to the Airbus ferry terminal and back to the university in the morning and at noon. Alternatively, you can take the ferry to Finkenwerder and then ride your bike for about another 15 minutes to the main entrance.

105560 | Data & AI | Professional | n.a. | Allianz Global Investors | Full-Time | Permanent

At Allianz Global Investors, we are shaping the future of investment management through technology, data, and innovation. To support this journey, we are looking for a forward-thinking and results-oriented Senior Quant Engineer (f/m/d) to join our Multi Asset Investment team in Frankfurt and enhance our Multi Asset strategies and systems.

In this role, you will help design and deliver scalable solutions that empower investment research, portfolio management, analytics, and AI-enabled use cases across our global Portfolio Management function. You will play a key role in advancing our data-driven investment processes by building robust data platforms, pipelines, and backend services in a modern, agile environment.

This role sits at the intersection of portfolio management, end-to-end quantitative system development, and IT. It is an exciting opportunity to take ownership from day one and contribute to a meaningful transformation of the investment management industry.

Technology is a critical differentiator in creating future-proof and competitive investment capabilities, and you will have the opportunity to shape solutions that make a real impact.

What you will do

- Collaborate closely with senior PMs on portfolio construction, optimization, and rebalancing frameworks.
- Work closely with investment teams, analysts, and architects to translate business and data requirements into scalable solutions.
- Implement and enhance scalable, modular backtesting and simulation frameworks for multi-asset and derivative strategies, incorporating real-world implementation constraints.
- Bring research models into production-grade investment and risk systems.
- Design and maintain end-to-end applications (including data ingestion, signal creation, portfolio construction, risk analysis, and monitoring).
- Design and manage large-scale financial and alternative data pipelines, transforming raw data into high-quality, model-ready datasets for specific investment use cases.
- Build and maintain backend components and APIs that provide reliable access to data products and platform services.
- Contribute to technical design decisions for data-intensive systems, ensuring scalability, performance, security, and compliance.
- Integrate AI/ML-driven approaches for feature engineering, signal extraction, and pattern recognition across macroeconomic and cross-asset datasets.

What you bring

- 5+ years of experience in data engineering, backend engineering, quantitative development/research, and/or portfolio management.
- University degree in Computer Science, Finance, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
- Good understanding of portfolio construction, preferably in a multi-asset context, core asset classes, and global markets.
- Good understanding of financial markets, futures (rates, equity indices, and commodities), and options (including delta, gamma, convexity, and implied volatility concepts).
- Knowledge of econometrics and statistical modeling.
- Hands-on experience in developing, deploying, and operating production-grade solutions in Python.
- Strong SQL and data modeling skills.
- Hands-on experience with data pipelines and data platforms.
- Familiarity with modern SDLC tools such as Git, GitHub/GitLab, and Jira; experience with Docker and Kubernetes is a plus.
- Exposure to AI, GenAI, and ML-enabled solutions is an advantage.
- Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to PMs and business requirements to engineering and platform teams.
- Strong written and spoken English skills.
- Agile mindset, collaborative working style, and a high level of ownership.
- Experience with AI and Machine Learning, Data Analytics, Data Integration, DevOps Technologies, Data Science.

What we offer

- We empower our employees by ensuring flexible work arrangements that maintain a balance between performance, productivity, career development and personal priorities (e.g., hybrid model/ flexible working hours)
- Securing your future: Access to company pension/savings plans
- Family support (relocation/ childcare facilities)
- Company share purchasing plan
- Mental health and wellbeing programs
- Mobility solutions (Jobrad bike leasing, subvention Jobticket)
- Career opportunities within the entire Allianz Group
- Self-guided learning & development
- … and so much more!

jobs.occupation: Design & Build Lead (all genders) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

Your Role:

As the ERP Design & Build Lead for our Life Science business, you will lead the design, governance, and continuous evolution of the global SAP S/4HANA process and system template as part of our global ERP transformation program. Working closely with Business Process and IT Solution Owners, Deployment Leads, and key members of our external implementation partners, you will drive the translation of business requirements into scalable, standardized, and compliant ERP solutions while maintaining the integrity of the global template across multiple deployments. You will provide leadership throughout the design and build lifecycle—from requirements and solution design through build completion, deployment readiness, and cutover support. Your leadership will ensure a high-quality, implementation-ready solution that enables successful global rollouts while preserving standardization and a clean-core architecture

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the end-to-end ERP Design & Build function within the global SAP S/4HANA transformation program.
- Own the governance, quality, and continuous evolution of the global ERP process and system template.
- Drive solution design activities, ensuring business requirements are translated into scalable, standardized, and compliant SAP solutions.
- Govern design decisions and ensure adherence to enterprise architecture principles, clean-core strategy, validation requirements, and global standards.
- Provide leadership and governance for the execution of design and build activities across functional workstreams and implementation partners, ensuring completeness, quality, and readiness for deployment.
- Ensure design consistency and template integrity across multiple concurrent deployment programs while balancing global standardization with justified local requirements.
- Partner closely with Deployment Leads to enable template confirmation, solution adoption, deployment readiness, cutover planning, and issue resolution.
- Provide governance across Application Integration, Data Migration, Testing, Validation, Security, and Platform teams to ensure an integrated, deployment-ready solution.
- Ensure ERP solutions are designed, built, and delivered in compliance with validation requirements and quality standards, partnering closely with Validation organizations to support deployment into regulated environments.
- Drive planning and governance for design, build, testing readiness, defect resolution, and cutover preparation across all functional domains.
- Identify technical and functional risks early and proactively manage dependencies that could impact deployment timelines or solution quality.
- Provide leadership and direction to internal teams, external implementation partners, and SAP, while driving accountability, delivery excellence, and effective collaboration.
- Leverage SAP S/4HANA innovations and emerging technologies to continuously improve the global ERP template and accelerate future deployments.

Who You Are:

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
- 10+ years of experience leading SAP S/4HANA design, build, and large-scale transformation programs, including significant experience with SAP S/4HANA.
- Extensive experience designing and governing global ERP templates within multinational organizations.
- Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA architecture and business processes across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Logistics, Finance, and Quality Management.
- Proven leadership experience managing global design and build teams across multiple functional workstreams and implementation partners.
- Strong knowledge of solution template governance, enterprise architecture, clean-core principles, and SAP implementation methodologies.
- Demonstrated experience leading ERP solution delivery in GxP-regulated Life Science, Pharmaceutical, Medical Device, or similarly regulated industries is highly desirable.
- Deep understanding of deployment readiness, testing, cutover governance, and transition from build to deployment.
- Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior business and IT leaders across global organizations.
- Outstanding communication and presentation skills, capable of translating complex technical concepts into business value.
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to balance standardization, business value, risk, and delivery timelines.
- Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams without direct authority in a matrix organization.
- Experience leading multiple concurrent initiatives within a global transformation program.
- Fluent in English (mandatory). German or another European language is considered an advantage.

This role does not offer sponsorship for work authorization. External applicants must be eligible to work in Germany.

What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!
